newsitem.title: USA: Whirlpool Brazil stakes seek tax credits.
newsitem.headline: Whirlpool Brazil stakes seek tax credits.

text.p: Whirlpool Corp said Monday two Brazilian companies in which it holds stakes have submitted tax-credit claims of 467 million reais, or about $440 million.
Multibras SA Eletrodomesticos and Empresa Brasileira de Compressores SA (Embraco) have submitted claims related to a Brazilian government export-incentive program, Whirlpool said.
Whirlpool said it owns about 37 percent of Multibras and 50 percent of Embraco.
Whirlpool said it has not recognized any income relating to the claims involving sales prior to 1997 because the timing and payment amount is uncertain.
According to Whirlpool, the companies said they should have received the credits under program provisions for exports from July 1988 through December 1996.

A Brazilian federal court had previously issued a final decision in favor of the companies. The court must render a final decision on the amount, the timing and the payment method of any final award. Multibras and Embraco could not estimate when a decision will be made, Whirlpool said.
